ex.s: SoFi Stadium is the go-to destination in the heart of Los Angeles for sports fans.
ex.t: SoFi体育场位于洛杉矶市中心，是体育迷们的首选目的地。

ex.s: Right across the street, Sonder Lüim Hotel offers spacious rooms and a rooftop pool.
ex.t: 就在街对面，Sonder Lüim酒店提供宽敞的客房和屋顶泳池。

ex.s: For those seeking both comfort and convenience, the Renaissance Los Angeles Airport Hotel is just a short drive away.
ex.t: 对于既追求舒适又讲究便利的人来说，洛杉矶机场万丽酒店只需短途车程即可到达。

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: If you enter through the wrong access point, you'll be turned around and redirected — so plan ahead.
ex.t: 如果你从错误的入口进入，会被拦下并重新指引——所以请提前规划。

ex.t: 她说，树木不应被视为敌人。

ex.t: 关于橡树和枫香树，这项新研究暗示了什么？

ex.t: 它们影响其他树木的生长。

ex.t: 它们使当地气温缓慢上升。

ex.t: 更换新种植树木的树种。

ex.t: 第五段中划线短语“oblivious to”是什么意思？

ex.s: In the study, 187 people were invited to visit Kettle’s Yard gallery during an exhibition of handmade clay objects.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，187人被邀请在手工陶器展期间参观Kettle’s Yard画廊。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美组在抽象思维上平均比控制组高出近14%。

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
ex.t: 在其中，效果更明显：有艺术爱好的“美”组在抽象思维上的平均得分比有艺术爱好的对照组高出25%以上。

ex.s: Emotional states of participants were also measured by asking about their feelings while completing the gallery task.
ex.t: 参与者的情绪状态也通过询问他们在完成画廊任务时的感受来衡量。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
ex.t: “我们在屏幕上做事情时，通常用非常具体的方式思考，”该研究的主要作者Simone Schnall说。

ex.s: “It’s becoming much rarer to zone out and just let the mind wander, but that’s when we think in ways that broaden our minds.
ex.t: “放空自己、任思绪自由漫游的机会越来越少，但那正是我们以开阔思维的方式思考的时候。

ex.s: Admiring the beauty of art may be the ideal way to initiate the abstract cognitive processes.”
ex.t: 欣赏艺术之美或许是开启抽象认知过程的理想方式。”

ex.s: What was the beauty group asked to do with the clay objects?
ex.t: 美感组被要求对这些陶艺品做什么？

ex.s: Which participants got the highest score on average in the test?
ex.t: 哪组参与者在测试中平均得分最高？

ex.s: Why were the participants’ emotional states measured?
ex.t: 为什么要测量参与者的情绪状态？

ex.s: To examine the difficulty of the tasks.
ex.t: 为了检验任务的难度。

ex.s: To determine factors behind the test results.
ex.t: 为了找出测试结果背后的因素。

ex.s: What is the major finding of the study regarding the appreciation of art?
ex.t: 关于艺术欣赏，这项研究的主要发现是什么？

ex.s: In short, AI is redefining the museum in all respects.
ex.t: 简而言之，人工智能正在从各个方面重新定义博物馆。

ex.t: 大集起源于古老的民间货物交易习俗，其历史可追溯到

ex.s: As the snow came down more and more heavily, Emily was directed off the highway.
ex.t: 雪越下越大，Emily被引导驶离了高速公路。

ex.s: Seeing no hope of immediate rescue, Emily decided to spend the night in her car.
ex.t: 眼看没有立即获救的希望，Emily决定在车里过夜。

ex.s: When Emily rolled down the window, Rachel asked if she was okay and told her it was not safe to stay overnight in the car.
ex.t: 当Emily摇下车窗时，Rachel问她是否还好，并告诉她整夜待在车里不安全。

ex.s: Grateful and relieved, Emily accepted the offer.
ex.t: 满怀感激和如释重负的埃米莉接受了这个提议。

ex.s: The Best Chinese Restaurants Around D.C.
ex.t: 华盛顿特区周边最好的中餐馆

ex.s: The D.C. area is home to many outstanding Chinese restaurants, but diners willing to travel outside the city limits will also be rewarded.
ex.t: 华盛顿特区有许多出色的中餐馆，但愿意走出市区就餐的食客也会有所收获。

ex.s: This not-so-hidden-anymore fine restaurant for Sichuan cuisine is inside the Days Inn off New York Avenue.
ex.t: 这家已不再那么隐秘的川菜精品餐厅位于纽约大道旁的戴斯酒店内。

ex.s: The restaurant is open from 11:00 am to 9:00 pm Tuesday through Sunday, offering call-in orders and pickups.
ex.t: 餐厅周二至周日上午11:00至晚上9:00营业，接受电话订餐和自取。

ex.s: The spacious dining room is regularly filled with customers enjoying dumplings and a variety of noodle and rice dishes.
ex.t: 宽敞的餐厅里经常坐满享用饺子以及各种面食和米饭菜肴的顾客。

ex.s: What do we know about the Cantonese restaurant in Columbia Heights?
ex.t: 关于哥伦比亚高地的那家粤餐厅，我们知道什么？

ex.s: The house where Reisley has lived for 73 years is located in the woods of Westchester County, New York, just 30 miles north of Manhattan.
ex.t: Reisley住了73年的房子位于纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的树林里，距曼哈顿以北仅30英里。

ex.s: The house has signature Wright features.
ex.t: 这座房子具有赖特的标志性特色。

ex.s: The house is now listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
ex.t: 这座房子如今已被列入《国家史迹名录》。

ex.s: He co-founded the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy, an organization engaged in the preservation of all of Wright’s remaining buildings.
ex.t: 他共同创立了Frank Lloyd Wright建筑保护协会，该组织致力于保护Wright现存的所有建筑。

ex.s: The convenience of its location.
ex.t: 那里位置的便利。

ex.s: The warmth of its residents.
ex.t: 那里居民的热情。

ex.s: The peak of Mount Qomolangma, 8,849 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 科莫朗格马山峰，海拔8,849米。

ex.s: Chimborazo, 6,263 m; Mont Blanc, 4,806 m; Pradidali hut, at the foot of the Pala group in the Dolomites, 2,278 m.

ex.s: This sense of uncertainty led me to think about the meaning of zero.
ex.t: 这种不确定感让我开始思考零的意义。

ex.s: This is how I began my search for the conceptual history of sea level.
ex.t: 我就是这样开始探寻海平面的概念史的。

ex.t: 作者在文章开头指出了什么？

ex.s: The concept of elevation is relative.
ex.t: 海拔的概念是相对的。

ex.s: The reference point is hard to locate.
ex.t: 参照点难以确定。

ex.s: How the altimeter was invented.
ex.t: 高度计是如何发明的。

ex.s: What initiated the author’s research.
ex.t: 是什么促使作者开展这项研究。

ex.s: Why the digital readings varied.
ex.t: 数字读数为什么会有差异。

ex.s: Where the author spent his holiday.
ex.t: 作者在哪里度过了假期。

ex.t: 海拔计：必备之物B.

ex.s: “And if it is from energy from the trains’ brakes, then even better.”
ex.t: “如果用的是列车刹车产生的能量，那就更好了。”

ex.s: Why does Barcelona launch the MetroCharge project?
ex.t: 巴塞罗那为什么启动MetroCharge项目？

ex.s: To fuel the city’s economy.
ex.t: 为了推动城市经济发展。

ex.s: To raise the quality of electric cars.
ex.t: 为了提高电动汽车的质量。

ex.s: What did Luna say about the system?
ex.t: 卢娜对这个系统说了什么？

ex.s: It prioritizes the safety of trains.
ex.t: 它把列车安全放在首位。

ex.s: It generates jobs for the locals.
ex.t: 它为当地人创造了就业机会。

ex.s: If only the effort they put into avoiding responsibility could be redirected into, well, actual responsibility.
ex.t: 要是他们用来逃避责任的那份力气能转移到——嗯——真正的责任上就好了。

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

ex.s: Few things strike fear into a child’s heart like the prospect of failing.
ex.t: 很少有东西像失败的预期那样能让孩子心里充满恐惧。

ex.s: Model the work ethic you want to see.
ex.t: 为孩子示范你希望看到的敬业精神。

ex.s: Sometimes, a cleaner living room is the best reward.
ex.t: 有时候，更整洁的客厅就是最好的奖励。

ex.s: In tai chi, the dan tian is your qi core and qi in Chinese means life force.
ex.t: 在太极拳中，丹田是你的气之核心，而“气”在中文里意为生命力。

ex.s: Today, we will only be doing the first nine.
ex.t: 今天我们只练前九式。

ex.s: Then, Angela gets us to try the nine movements on our own.
ex.t: 然后，Angela让我们自己试着做这九个动作。

ex.s: I found comfort in keeping myself awake when everyone else had gone to bed, and I loved the silence of the night.
ex.t: 用大写字母写的“安静”标志到处都是。如果她觉得你穿得不合适，她会直接让你回家换衣服。

ex.s: When I finally started to study, I would race through the assigned work, often well past midnight.
ex.t: 等我终于开始学习时，我会匆匆忙忙赶完布置的作业，常常早已过了午夜。

ex.s: Struck by the doctor’s warning, I knew I had to make a change.
ex.t: 被医生的警告触动，我知道自己必须做出改变。

ex.s: Slowly but surely, my efforts to adjust to the new routine paid off.
ex.t: 我努力适应新作息，缓慢但稳步地见到了成效。

ex.s: This project will select 10 visual artists and 10 writers to create artwork that will be displayed on temporary signs along the multi-use path.
ex.t: 该项目将选出10名视觉艺术家和10名作家，创作将在多功能步道沿线的临时标牌上展出的作品。

ex.s: Often students come to the classroom believing that learning can’t be fun and that what they learn isn’t relevant to the real world — much less to their personal interests.
ex.t: 学生们常常带着这样的看法走进教室：学习不可能有趣，所学内容与现实世界无关——更谈不上与他们的个人兴趣有关。

ex.s: No matter what subject I’m teaching, I find ways to bring my hobbies into the classroom.
ex.t: 无论教什么科目，我都会想办法把我的爱好带进课堂。

ex.s: But I quickly learned that the practice also helped me build stronger relationships with them.
ex.t: 但我很快发现，这种做法还帮助我与学生建立了更牢固的关系。

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现，这样做让我的教学更有活力，让学生更投入，也向他们展示了抽象概念在现实世界中的实际运用。

ex.s: What poses a challenge to teachers according to the author?
ex.t: 根据作者的看法，对教师构成挑战的是什么？

ex.s: The gap between teachers’ and students’ hobbies.
ex.t: 老师与学生爱好之间的差距。

ex.s: Why does the author bring tires into the classroom?
ex.t: 作者为什么把轮胎带进课堂？

ex.s: To explain the structure of a car.
ex.t: 解释汽车的结构。

ex.s: What was the unexpected outcome of the author’s teaching method?
ex.t: 作者的教学方法带来了什么意想不到的结果？

ex.s: The study used a dataset of 1,600 reviews of Chicago hotels.
ex.t: 该研究使用了1600条芝加哥酒店评论的数据集。

ex.s: The reviews were presented to 400 subjects.
ex.t: 这些评论被呈现给400名受试者。

ex.s: The reviews were written by real people who were given information about the hotel.
ex.t: 这些评论是由真实的人写的，他们拿到了关于酒店的信息。

ex.s: The results show that consumers generally trust negative reviews more than positive ones.
ex.t: 结果表明，消费者总体上更相信负面评论而不是正面评论。

ex.s: Azimi says study participants tended not to trust reviews where the writers expressed their feelings in a big way.
ex.t: Azimi说，研究参与者往往不相信那些作家们以很大方式表达其感情的评论。

ex.s: The fake reviews written for Azimi’s study were put together by humans, but increasingly, fake reviews are being written by AI, which makes them look more real.
ex.t: Azimi研究中使用的虚假评论由真人编写，但越来越多的虚假评论正由人工智能撰写，这使它们看起来更加真实。

ex.s: Which aspect of the study does paragraph 2 mainly talk about?
ex.t: 第2段主要谈了研究的哪个方面？

ex.s: What does the underlined word “glowing” in paragraph 4 mean?
ex.t: 第四段中划线词“glowing”是什么意思？

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: This allows the Salk team to determine what genes are most beneficial to their plant designs.
ex.t: 这使 Salk 团队能够确定哪些基因对他们的植物设计最有益。

ex.s: “We’re not just ‘borrowing’ from different disciplines — we’re really putting them on equal footing in order to create something greater than the sum of its parts.”
ex.t: "我们不仅仅是在不同学科间'借用'——我们真正地将它们放在平等的位置上，以创造出比各部分总和更伟大的东西。"

ex.s: What do the scientists at Salk Institute hope to achieve?
ex.t: 萨尔克研究所的科学家们希望实现什么？

ex.s: Optimizing the use of energy.
ex.t: 优化能源的使用。

ex.s: What will SLEAP help the scientists do?
ex.t: SLEAP将帮助科学家做什么？

ex.s: Pick out diseased plants in the forestB.
ex.t: 从森林中挑选出患病植物。

ex.s: Preserve the genes of endangered plants.
ex.t: 保护濒危植物的基因。

ex.s: Napping and daydreaming are habits caused by lack of involvement with the material.
ex.t: 打盹和白日梦是由于缺乏对材料的投入而形成的习惯。

ex.s: Be demanding on yourself and expect 100 percent attention to the task.
ex.t: 对自己严格要求，期待百分之百的注意力投入到任务中。

ex.s: Probably the latter is true.
ex.t: 可能后者是正确的。

ex.s: Don’t just read the words; think the ideas.
ex.t: 不要只阅读文字；要思考其中的思想。

ex.s: Spend a few minutes reading the material aloud.
ex.t: 花几分钟大声朗读材料。

ex.s: Then, start denying yourself the right in order to break the habit.
ex.t: 然后，开始拒绝自己的这种权利以打破这个习惯。

ex.s: My mum would find fun even when completing the most boring of tasks.
ex.t: 妈妈即使在完成最无聊的任务时也能找到乐趣。

ex.s: I realise now that Mum didn’t find the joy in these tasks: she created it.
ex.t: 我现在才明白，妈妈并不是在这些任务中找到快乐：是她创造了快乐。

ex.s: The teachers praised her, and friends gathered around her, requesting her to sing.
ex.t: 老师们称赞她，朋友们围在她身边，请求她唱歌。

ex.s: When the cashier rang everything up, my dad reached for his wallet and froze.
ex.t: 当收银员把所有东西扫码结算后，我爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: About the Programme
ex.t: 关于这个项目

ex.s: Schedule the projects.
ex.t: 组织创意工作坊。

ex.s: How did the author feel after hearing her dad’s response?
ex.t: 听到父亲回答后作者感觉如何？

ex.s: What does the story mainly tell us?
ex.t: 这个故事主要告诉了我们什么？

ex.s: Silence is the best cure for nostalgia.
ex.t: 沉默是治疗乡愁最好的良药。

ex.s: Distance makes the heart grow fonder.
ex.t: 距离使人更加思念。

ex.s: Optimism lights the path for tomorrow.
ex.t: 乐观照亮通往明天的道路。

ex.s: Parenting sets the pace of a child’s growth.
ex.t: 养育子女决定了儿童成长的速度。

ex.s: “And therefore, the perception of how the forest smells changes.”
ex.t: 这种影响不仅限于森林。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 雪——已受到气候变暖的威胁——随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变它清冷洁净的气味。

ex.s: Warmer conditions can intensify smells, leading the snow to smell more unpleasant and potentially gather more pollutants.
ex.t: 气候变化也在加速生物多样性的丧失，威胁要彻底消除某些气味。

ex.s: Climate change is also quickening the loss of biodiversity, threatening to erase certain smells entirely.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们的气味变得更加难以产生。

ex.s: The damage to the scentscape could result in harm to both health and spiritual practice.
ex.t: 气味景观的破坏可能对健康和精神修行都造成损害。

ex.s: If we don’t look at it, we lose all the richness behind it.
ex.t: 如果我们不去审视它，我们就会失去它背后所有的丰富内涵。

ex.s: In an earlier era, the Disruptor would have been called an Innovator.
ex.t: 然而创新者是创造新事物，而颠覆者的定义既在于他们创造的，同样也在于他们摧毁的。

ex.s: The Disruptor forces change; the clean-up is somebody else’s problem.
ex.t: 这种态度最好概括为"快速行动，打破常规"。

ex.s: To us, now, the fence seems to be nothing but an impediment.

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.t: 当然，没有人真正知道，但播种仍在继续。

ex.t: 在土壤中保存水分。

ex.t: 防止冰雹的形成。

ex.t: 为什么多斯韦尔博士提到他在1999年看到的龙卷风？

ex.t: 为了说明大冰雹的发展过程。

ex.t: 为了展示风暴与水分之间的联系。

ex.t: 在米歇尔的实验中，孩子们需要怎么做才能得到第二份零食？

ex.t: 既然我们现在处于信息时代，我们就有了诸如计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: The most obvious advantage of online learning is that you can study anywhere and anytime.
ex.t: 在线学习最明显的优势是你可以随时随地学习。

ex.s: You can also find students on the class discussion board to organize a study group, or schedule in-person meetings with your professor to discuss course concepts.
ex.t: 你也可以在课堂讨论板上找同学组建学习小组，或约教授当面讨论课程概念。

ex.s: Professor Alex Davidson teaches the same course in person and online.
ex.t: 亚历克斯·戴维森教授亲自和在线教授同一门课程。

ex.s: My   43   friend spoke virtually no English, so I happily took the   44   to practice my Chinese.
ex.t: 我的43个朋友几乎不会说英语，所以我很高兴用44来练习中文。

ex.s: Eva spent the first week of high school trying to keep her head above water.
ex.t: Eva在高中第一周努力让自己勉强维持下去。

ex.s: All the different hallways and rooms were too much to think about, let alone commit to memory.
ex.t: 所有的走廊和房间各不相同，多到让人难以想象，更别说记在心里。

ex.s: She searched the faces of her classmates for signs of panic.
ex.t: 当某事与他们的观点矛盾时，他们不会将其视为例外。

ex.s: “It’s just the beginning,” she thought.
ex.t: 但我对自己的能力过于乐观了。

ex.s: He explained it's not about the grades; it's about true understanding.
ex.t: 他解释说，这与分数无关，而是与真正的理解有关。

ex.s: Another issue is that the human brain is highly sensitive to wasted effort.
ex.t: 营员享受的师生比根据年龄组从1:4到1:7不等。

ex.s: So how does the brain process motivation?
ex.t: 那么大脑是如何处理动机的呢？

ex.s: And your “ought” self is the self that does what you ought to be doing to become your “ideal” self.
ex.t: 但随着减废的月份持续下去，我在自己力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: Most people have the habit of doing physical exercise.
ex.t: 大多数人都有做体育锻炼的习惯。

ex.t: 根据作者的说法，人类与许多其他物种有什么不同？

ex.s: The first book I picked up was Montaigne's Essays.
ex.t: 我拿起的第一本书是蒙田的《随笔集》。

ex.s: It's the next one that is important!
ex.t: 下一个才是重要的！

ex.s: My reaction to the renewed reading no longer corresponded to the original experience, and I was no longer sure that I recognized myself as the same reader.
ex.t: 我对重新阅读的反应不再与最初的体验相符，我也不再确定我能认出自己是同一个读者。

ex.s: Renewed contact with a novel or a poem can activate the search for a better knowledge of the self.
ex.t: 意义是通过社会互动的过程产生的，而非计算过程，这种互动塑造了我们头脑中符号的内容。

ex.s: What did the author find when reading Montaigne’s Essays?
ex.t: 作者在读蒙田的《随笔集》时发现了什么？

ex.s: To improve the quality of teaching.
ex.t: 为了提高教学质量。

ex.s: What could be the best title for the passage?
ex.t: 这篇文章的最佳标题可能是什么？

ex.s: Despite her encouraging smile, I wanted to sink through the floor because I was unsure about its pronunciation as well as its meaning.
ex.t: 尽管她面带鼓励的微笑，我却恨不得找个地缝钻进去，因为我不确定它的发音，也不确定它的意思。

ex.s: Why was Addie asked to recite Longfellow’s poem to the Saturday evening’s club?
ex.t: 为什么阿迪被要求在周六晚上的俱乐部上朗诵朗费罗的诗？

ex.s: To set an example for the rest of the class.
ex.t: 为了给班上其他同学树立榜样。

ex.s: What can be learned about Miss Chevalier’s personality from the way she treated Addie?
ex.t: 从舍瓦利耶小姐对待艾迪的方式可以了解到她怎样的性格？

ex.s: How did Miss Chevalier succeed in making Addie truly understand the word “impetuous”?
ex.t: 谢瓦利埃小姐是如何让阿迪真正理解"impetuous"这个词的？

ex.s: By interpreting the two definitions separately.
ex.t: 通过分别解释这两个定义。

ex.s: By consulting the dictionary for its definitions.
ex.t: 通过查阅词典获取其定义。

ex.s: What is the probable reason that Addie would never call Miss Chevalier “Poodle” again?
ex.t: 艾迪再也不会叫舍瓦利耶小姐“贵宾犬”的可能原因是什么？

ex.s: Eventually, researchers made a prediction that progressive warming during the 21st and 22nd centuries would dry out the Arctic, and lakes would begin to shrink.
ex.t: 最终，研究人员做出预测：21和22世纪逐步变暖将使北极变干，湖泊将开始萎缩。

ex.s: The frozen solid ground actually contains bits of rock, mineral and organic matter, leaving spaces in between.
ex.t: 冻得坚硬的地面实际上包含岩石、矿物和有机物的微粒，在它们之间留下了空隙。

ex.s: And because these spaces are filled with solid ice, liquid water cannot readily get inside, but it can when the permafrost melts, allowing more water to get through.
ex.t: 由于这些空间充满了坚实的冰，液态水不容易进入其中，但当永久冻土融化时就可以，从而让更多的水渗透过去。

ex.s: Yet none of the existing models includes such processes.
ex.t: 然而，现有的模型中没有一个包含这样的过程。

ex.t: 水面快速上涨。B. 永久冻土更快融化。

ex.s: Why is the frozen Arctic ground hard for water to get through?
ex.t: 为什么冻结的北极地面坚硬，水难以渗入？

ex.s: Because of the solid ice within it.
ex.t: 因为它内部有坚硬的冰。

ex.s: Because it is far away from the waters.
ex.t: 因为它离水域很远。

ex.s: What lesson can we learn from the passage?
ex.t: 我们从这篇文章中可以学到什么教训？

ex.s: She often asks this, and I always answer the same way—“To have Granddad back” —which usually gets her reminiscing about him.
ex.t: 她常这么问，而我也总是同样的回答——“让爷爷回来”——这通常会让她陷入对他的回忆。

ex.s: Even at 93, my grandmother still knits blankets for the local hospital’s babies and buys books to continue with her French.
ex.t: 即使到了93岁，我的祖母仍然为当地医院的婴儿织毯子，还买书继续学法语。

ex.t: 根据作者祖母的说法，人们如何才能在老年活得精彩？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: The school grew in popularity so quickly that Drewry realized she would need more space outside her home for the classes.

ex.t: "所有烹饪设施都是家用的。

ex.t: 学校为3到13岁的孩子提供针对性活动。

ex.t: 活动的有趣之处在于，孩子们可以吃掉或带回家他们做的任何东西。

ex.s: They can also enjoy themselves in the themed classes like Harry Potter or Winter Wonder-land Baking.
ex.t: 他们还可以在哈利·波特或冬季仙境烘焙等主题课上尽情玩耍。

ex.t: 有了所有这些活动，学校极受欢迎。

ex.t: 考虑到孩子的身高，学校是如何设计教室的？（不超过10个词）

ex.t: 根据第5段，为什么这所学校这么受欢迎？（不超过10词）

ex.s: I entered the room and the teachers made me say some lines from the musical.
ex.t: 我走进房间，老师们让我念了音乐剧里的几句台词。

ex.s: The teachers were smiling and praising me.
ex.t: 老师们微笑着称赞我。

ex.t: 他的眼镜飞了出去，落在草地上。

ex.t: 当我把眼镜递给他时，他看着我说："谢谢！"

ex.t: •学生报名并注明他们能够分享的语言和他们有兴趣学习的语言。

ex.t: 报名该项目并不自动意味着你将能够注册并参与。

ex.t: 由于配对过程中涉及许多因素，并非所有报名的学生都能匹配到搭档并注册该项目。

ex.t: 学生在注册期间需要做什么？

ex.s: When I was a little girl, I liked drawing, freely and joyously making marks on the walls at home.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，自由而快乐地在家里墙上涂画。

ex.t: 作者对美术考试结果的感受如何？

ex.t: 努力工作是成功之母。

ex.s: Dreams are the reflections of realities.
ex.t: 梦境是现实的反映。

ex.s: The notion that we live in someone else’s video game is irresistible to many.
ex.t: 我们生活在别人电子游戏中的想法对许多人来说很有吸引力。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: Models are not the reality, however.

ex.s: All these models are tools to deal with the unknown and to make discoveries.
ex.t: 所有这些模型都是应对未知和做出发现的工具。

ex.s: And the more tools we have, the more effective and insightful we can become.
ex.t: 我们拥有的工具越多，我们的效率和洞察力就越强。

ex.t: 第二段中划线的短语"contingent on"可能是什么意思？

ex.s: continue exploring the classical models in history
ex.t: 继续探索历史上的经典模型

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 道德美德在各文化间的相似性令人惊叹，尽管这些美德的相对排序可能随社会群体的历史和环境而变化。

ex.s: These universal norms far pre-date the concept of any moralising religion or written law.
ex.t: 这些普遍规范远早于任何宗教道德化观念或成文法律的出现。

ex.s: The approval of others is rewarding, while their disapproval is strongly disliked.
ex.t: 别人的认可是有回报的，而他们的不认可则强烈的厌恶。

ex.s: We learn to tell the truth, even when lying is self-serving; we help a grandparent even when it is inconvenient.
ex.t: 我们学会说真话，即使说谎对自己有利；我们帮助祖父母，即使这很不方便。

ex.s: In humans, a greatly enlarged brain boosts self-control, just as it boosts problem-solving skills in the social as well as the physical world.
ex.t: 在人类身上，显著增大的大脑增强了自控力，正如它也增强了我们在社会和物质世界中解决问题的能力。

ex.s: What can be inferred about the forming of the Inuit’s moral code?
ex.t: 关于因纽特人道德准则的形成，能推断出什么？

ex.s: Living conditions were the drive.
ex.t: 生活条件是驱动力。

ex.s: Unwritten rules were the target.
ex.t: 不成文的规则是目标。

ex.t: C 社会传统是基础。

ex.s: A few months later, when I repeated the experiment in my home lab, I produced more publishable data.
ex.t: 几个月后，当我在自己的实验室重复这项实验时，我产出了更多可发表的数据。

ex.s: By learning when to ask for help, I eventually found myself on the way to becoming an independent scientist.
ex.t: 通过学习何时寻求帮助，我最终走上了成为独立科学家的道路。

ex.t: 几乎没有任何成绩，除了“你在朝目标努力吗？”基本上就是“我得做出这个产品，然后年底把它展示给NASA。”工程师真的会来做当面评审，而且……这有时并不是件愉快的事。

ex.s: When we fail at the right thing, persistence makes sense.
ex.t: 当我们在正确的事情上失败时，坚持是有意义的。

ex.s: A mile away, the H Hotel Los Angeles, with its stylish design, is ideal for a nice stay between events.
ex.t: 一英里外，洛杉矶H酒店以其时尚的设计，是赛事间隙惬意下榻的理想之选。

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: Each parking zone consists of multiple lots, designed to efficiently manage traffic across the venue’s network.
ex.t: 每个停车区由多个停车场组成，旨在高效管理整个场地的交通。

ex.s: Upon entering the correct zone, parking staff will guide you directly to a space.
ex.t: 一旦进入正确的区域，停车管理员会直接引导你到车位。

ex.s: Not long ago, my fifth-grade son Kevin asked me about the meaning of a word in a novel.
ex.t: 不久前，我上五年级的儿子凯文问我一本小说里一个词的意思。

ex.s: I took down one of the dictionaries, and we read it together for a few minutes before I handed it to him.
ex.t: 我取下其中一本词典，我们一起读了几分钟，然后递给了他。

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.
ex.t: 他翻着书页，睁大眼睛不停地说：“怎么会有这么多词？”过了一会儿，他看着我问：“妈妈，你认识所有这些词吗？”我笑着说：“我确实不认识所有这些词。”

ex.s: I felt a small pain in my chest The dictionary was stolen at the end of my freshman year of college.
ex.t: 我感到胸口隐隐作痛。那本词典在我大学一年级结束时被偷了。

ex.s: What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word?
ex.t: 凯文通常是怎么弄懂一个词的意思的？

ex.s: What can we learn about the author's first dictionary?
ex.t: 关于作者的第一本词典，我们能了解到什么？

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 目前占城市树木大多数的橡树和枫香树，会释放大量一种叫做异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: “We’re not going to go cutting down any big old oaks,” and neither will the department completely stop planting new ones, said Auyeung.
ex.t: “我们不会去砍任何一棵高大的老橡树，”Auyeung说，管理局也不会完全停止种植新树。

ex.s: Doing more research on the problem.
ex.t: 对这一问题做更多研究。

ex.s: While they were told the study was about cognitive processes, participants were asked about interests, with around half saying they had an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 虽然参与者被告知这项研究是关于认知过程的，但他们也被问及兴趣爱好，约一半人说自己有艺术爱好。

ex.s: The blinding whiteout made driving nearly impossible.
ex.t: 令人眩目的白茫一片让驾驶几乎无法进行。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 一番挣扎后，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: “I am the last original client of Frank Lloyd Wright, still living in the home he designed for me,” Reisley said, sitting in the bright open living room of the home designed by the famous architect.
ex.t: “我是弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特最后一位健在的原始客户，至今仍住在他为我设计的房子里，”Reisley坐在由这位著名建筑师设计的明亮通透的客厅里说道。

ex.s: It’s one of 47 that make up the peaceful mid-20th-century modern village of Usonia.
ex.t: 它是组成Usonia这座宁静的20世纪中期现代风格村庄的47座住宅之一。

ex.s: On their first trip out, they were greeted with such enthusiasm from the 10 families who’d already established homes there that they decided to join.
ex.t: 第一次实地探访时，已在那里安家的10户人家热情相迎，这让他们决定加入。

ex.s: Over the decades, Reisley has opened his doors to visitors.
ex.t: 几十年来，赖斯利一直向访客敞开大门。

ex.s: Reisley believes that his devotion to the home and the community are what have kept him in such good health all of these years.
ex.t: Reisley相信，正是对这座房子和这片社区的热爱，让他多年来一直保持着如此好的健康状态。

ex.s: What can be inferred about Reisley from the last paragraph?
ex.t: 从最后一段能推断出关于雷伊斯利的什么？

ex.s: That the concept has a history is easily ignored.
ex.t: 这个概念有其历史，这一点很容易被忽视。

ex.s: Appropriately, the book took shape during a summer spent between sea and mountains.
ex.t: 恰如其分地，这本书是在一个穿梭于海与山之间的夏天里成形的。

ex.s: A month after visiting the French Riviera and enjoying the sandy beaches of Nice and Menton, I went hiking with friends in the Pala group.
ex.t: 在游览法国里维埃拉、享受尼斯和芒通沙滩一个月后，我和朋友去Pala山群徒步。

ex.s: Since I began thinking about this project in August 2011, the issue of sea-level rise and the need to place it historically have only become more urgent: between then and the end of 2022 the global sea rose by almost 5 centimeters, about half of the overall rise recorded by satellites since 1993.
ex.t: 自从我在2011年8月开始思考这个项目，海平面上升的问题以及将其置于历史背景的必要性变得更加紧迫：从那时到2022年底，全球海平面上升了近5厘米，约为卫星自1993年以来记录的总升幅的一半。

ex.s: What does the underlined word “it” refer to in the last paragraph?
ex.t: 最后一段中划线词“it”指什么？

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那已经汇集了一整套清洁能源技术，以帮助公共交通走向绿色，同时也在应对气候变化并帮助欧洲艰难地转向私人拥有的电动车辆市场方面尽了自己的职责。

ex.s: Bernardo Espinoza, an engineer who takes the subway every day, owns an electric car.
ex.t: 贝尔纳多·埃斯皮诺萨是一名每天乘地铁的工程师，他拥有一辆电动汽车。

ex.s: “I am pleasantly surprised, because I am always looking for where to plug it in,” Espinoza said before catching the subway in a working-class area of southern Barcelona.
ex.t: “我感到惊喜，因为我一直在找哪里能给车充电，”Espinoza在南巴塞罗那一个工人阶层社区赶地铁前说道。

ex.s: You can’t expect your child to tackle their tasks with enthusiasm while you’re complaining about loading the dishwasher.
ex.t: 你不能一边抱怨着把碗碟放进洗碗机，一边指望孩子满怀热情地完成自己的任务。

ex.s: Not every child is born with the willpower of a marathon runner.
ex.t: 并非每个孩子都生来就有马拉松选手那样的意志力。

ex.s: Bent over my laptop while sitting on the bed in the corner of my room, I suddenly felt a pounding headache, and had to lie down.
ex.t: 我弓着背坐在房间角落的床上盯着笔记本电脑，突然感到一阵剧烈的头痛，不得不躺下。

ex.s: At the school clinic, a doctor, with a serious expression on his face, handed me a medical report.
ex.t: 在学校诊所，一位表情严肃的医生递给我一份体检报告。

ex.s: The City of Burlington public art program is presenting a series of temporary public art signs at the Beachway in conjunction with the Ontario Culture Days.
ex.t: Burlington市公共艺术项目正与安大略文化节合作，在Beachway展出一系列临时公共艺术标识。

ex.s: Artist Biography: Please provide a short introduction (maximum 50 words) to the artist written in the third person.
ex.t: 艺术家简介：请用第三人称写一段简短的艺术家介绍（最多50词）。

ex.s: Which of the following meets the application requirements?
ex.t: 以下哪一项符合申请要求？

ex.s: Which of the following best describes the author as a teacher?
ex.t: 以下哪项最能描述作者作为一名教师的特点？

ex.s: Human beings have always loved reviews: word of mouth has long been regarded as one of the most valuable marketing tools available to a company.
ex.t: 人类一直喜爱评论：口碑长期以来被视为公司可用的最有价值的营销工具之一。

ex.s: A lengthy, positive review, on the other hand, was regarded as suspicious, and participants tended to trust writers that kept their glowing reviews short.
ex.t: 另一方面，一条冗长而正面的评价被认为是可疑的，参与者倾向于信任那些保持他们热情洋溢的评论简短的作家。

ex.s: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
ex.t: 从最后一段可以推断出什么？

ex.s: Scientists at Salk Institute are making use of the natural capacity of plants to absorb carbon dioxide by enhancing their root systems.
ex.t: 萨尔克研究所的科学家正在利用植物吸收二氧化碳的自然能力，通过增强其根系来实现这一目标。

ex.s: To design these climate-saving plants, the scientists are using a research tool called SLEAP — an AI software that tracks multiple features of root growth.
ex.t: 为了设计这些拯救气候的植物，科学家们正在使用一种名为SLEAP的研究工具——一款追踪根系生长多项特征的AI软件。

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: Ursula has always called the beautiful small town of Beaverton her home.
ex.t: 乌苏拉一直把美丽的小镇比弗顿称为她的家。

ex.s: A family member is returning from a year-long trip, and you are meeting her at the airport.
ex.t: 一位家人结束长达一年的旅行归来，你正在机场接她。

ex.s: We moved them in with us until the build was complete.
ex.t: 我们把他们搬来和我们一起住，直到建造完成。

ex.s: On our final morning in the house, we took a break from the mind-bending, never-ending work of packing to sit down for that last breakfast.
ex.t: 在老房子里的最后一个早晨，我们从令人头疼、没完没了的打包工作中歇下来，坐下来吃最后一顿早餐。

ex.s: Sitting at the table, making my mini sandwich, I realised I was ready for our next chapter.
ex.t: 坐在桌前做我的迷你三明治时，我意识到我已经为我们的下一个篇章做好了准备。

ex.s: A recent study reported that native communities in Peru noticed a change in the smell of the Amazon River due to industrial pollution.
ex.t: 最近一项研究报告称，秘鲁的原住民社区注意到由于工业污染，亚马逊河的气味发生了变化。

ex.s: Scents of the missing plants are preserved in the atmosphere.
ex.t: 森林和雪的气味变化有一个共同的潜在原因。

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们以前从未有过的新类型专业人士——或者即使不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: Chesterton identified the core problem with moving fast and breaking things through a thought experiment.
ex.t: Chesterton通过一个思想实验指出了“快速行动、打破陈规”的核心问题。

ex.s: We need the ability to work out which messes are worth avoiding — because however impressively fast you move, some things can’t be easily unbroken.
ex.t: 我们需要具备分辨哪些混乱值得避免的能力——因为无论你行动得多快，有些东西一旦打破就很难复原。

ex.s: Helping strangers can leave you with a deep sense of satisfaction, but you’ve likely also felt the stress of showing up for others when you’re already stretched thin.
ex.t: 帮助陌生人会给你一种深深的满足感，但你也可能体会过在自己已经分身乏术时还要为他人付出的压力。

ex.s: There is a famous story about the Scottish king Robert the Bruce.
ex.t: 有一个关于苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯的著名故事。

ex.s: It stops on the stone floor — and then turns, moving slowly towards a different corner of the cave, where the wind is calmer and the flies more plentiful.
ex.t: 它停在石地上——然后转身，缓缓爬向洞穴的另一个角落，那里风更平静，苍蝇也更多。

ex.s: How can you apply the idea of “moving towards a different corner” to a real-life challenge?
ex.t: 你如何把“走向另一个角落”的想法应用到现实生活中的挑战上？

ex.s: The greening of planes, trains and automobiles
ex.t: "我觉得这是个很棒的主意，"塔尼亚·佩里利说，她经营着一家服装租赁店。

ex.s: Much is still to be settled, but here are some of the solutions to get us going green.
ex.t: 还有很多问题有待解决，但以下是一些帮助我们走向绿色的解决方案。

ex.s: It’s estimated that the global demand for electricity could more than double by 2050.
ex.t: 据估计，到2050年，全球电力需求可能增长一倍以上。

ex.s: Fortunately, analyses suggest that renewables are up to the task.
ex.t: 幸运的是，分析表明可再生能源能够胜任这一任务。

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 去年在我九年级的写作课上，我遇到了一个拯救了小镇的牛仔、一个要求儿子门门得A的严厉父亲，以及一个在现代版朱丽叶——她在父母拒绝了她年轻生命中的挚爱后，因心碎而死。

ex.s: This time they found the exercise much more interesting.
ex.t: 那个男人僵了一秒，但当他看到这个瘦弱的男孩时松了一口气。

ex.s: When the final bell rang in June, I walked away with a yearbook full of messages about writing’s most powerful significance — the ability to connect people, to put us in another’s skin, to teach us what it means to be human.
ex.t: 当六月的下课铃响起，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些话道出了写作最强大的意义——把人们连接起来、让我们设身处地、教会我们生而为人的含义。

ex.s: Why did the students perform poorly in writing their first essay?
ex.t: 为什么学生们在写第一篇作文时表现很差？

ex.s: Many parents say there’s too much traffic on the roads for their children to walk safely to school, so they pack them into the car instead.
ex.t: 这是我从未体验过的一种快感。

ex.s: Most famously, a Canadian journalist who had moved her family to Manhattan in the early 1950s led a campaign to stop the destruction of her local park.
ex.t: 最著名的是，一位加拿大记者在1950年代初将她的家人迁至曼哈顿，他领导了一场停止她当地公园被毁的运动。

ex.s: What phenomenon does the author point out in paragraph 1?
ex.t: 作者在第一段指出了什么现象？

ex.s: Still, the findings show a potential path forward for reducing microplastic exposure — a task that’s becoming increasingly difficult.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这些发现为减少微塑料摄入指明了一条可行的路径——这是一项正变得愈发困难的任务。

ex.s: The new study suggests boiling tap water could be a tool to limit intake.
ex.t: 这项新研究表明，煮沸自来水可能是一个限制摄入的工具。

ex.s: How does the author present the issue in the first paragraph?
ex.t: 作者在第一段是如何呈现这一问题的？

ex.s: The type of plastic in water.
ex.t: 水中的塑料类型。

ex.s: The severity of the microplastic problem.
ex.t: 我重新定义成功的第一步始于选课。

ex.s: Need a break between classes or just a quick pick-me-up in the morning?
ex.t: 课间需要休息一下，或只是早上想提提神？

ex.s: The cafe closes at 9 pm every day.
ex.t: 咖啡馆每天晚上9点关门。

ex.s: After finishing an order, she calls out the name on the cup.
ex.t: 完成一单后，她会喊出杯子上写的名字。

ex.s: Going to the cafe starts her day off good and gets her ready for class.
ex.t: 去咖啡馆让她有了一个美好的开端，也为上课做好了准备。

ex.s: I really like the idea of adding a new column to our English newspaper.
ex.t: 我真的很喜欢在我们的英文报上新增一个栏目的想法。

ex.s: I didn’t want Toby to be running around in the house, and my brother wasn’t happy with driving home with a wet dog.
ex.t: 我不想让Toby在屋里乱跑，而我弟弟也不乐意开着车带着一只湿漉漉的狗回家。

ex.s: English Market Towns to Visit in the UK
ex.t: 英国值得一游的英格兰集镇

ex.s: Each has a personality shaped by the goods and services produced and traded for centuries.
ex.t: 每个地方都有一种由数百年来生产和交易的商品和服务所塑造的独特个性。

ex.s: One of the four original copies of the Magna Carta is displayed there.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯是五列政府资助的医疗列车之一，行驶至俄罗斯中部和东部的偏远城镇。

ex.s: Butcher shops, greengrocers, bakeries, and cheese shops line the town square.
ex.t: 肉铺、果蔬店、面包店和奶酪店排列在小镇广场周围。

ex.s: Bordering the square, the Ludlow Castle is a “must explore” medieval stronghold.
ex.t: 城堡Ludlow紧邻广场，是一座“必探”的中世纪要塞。

ex.s: The three-day Ludlow Food Festival is held each September.
ex.t: 为期三天的拉德洛美食节每年九月举行。

ex.s: The River Severn has a significant turn through town, almost making an island of Shrewsbury Town Center.
ex.t: 塞文河在镇上急转，几乎把Shrewsbury镇中心变成一座岛屿。

ex.s: The shape creates a perfect market where goods could be shipped and received using the river as a highway.
ex.t: 这一地形造就了一个完美的市场，货物可以借河流这条“高速公路”运进运出。

ex.s: Don’t leave the harbor without a traditional Cornish pie.
ex.t: 离开港口前，别忘了尝一个传统的康沃尔馅饼。

ex.s: The hospital school is free of parents, doctors, and medical procedures.
ex.t: 这对我来说是一个恍然大悟的时刻，从此我再也不会以同样的方式看待结局了。

ex.s: “I feel like it is a disservice to the kids,” Ho says.
ex.t: “我觉得这对孩子们是一种伤害，”何说。

ex.s: “I actually think the medicine is only a small piece for some problems,” says Julie Good, director of pain management services at LPCH.
ex.t: “其实我认为，对一些问题来说，药物只是很小的一部分，”LPCH疼痛管理服务主任Julie Good说。

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国 Silo 这样的餐厅已尝试过零浪费系统，但 wastED 采取了更进一步的方式……

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，它从一开始就被设计成短期实验；Blue Hill此后已恢复常规菜单。

ex.s: Volunteering makes you feel capable and inspires you to make the most of each day.
ex.t: 志愿服务让你感到自己有能力，并激励你充分利用每一天。

ex.s: Every time I gave a self-introduction, I had to explain how to pronounce my name at least five times, yet they still could not say it the way I did.
ex.t: 每次我作自我介绍时，都不得不把我的名字怎么读解释至少五遍，可他们还是说不出我那种读法。

ex.s: Once in a lecture, the professor tried repeating my name after me over and over in front of thirty classmates.
ex.t: 有一次在课上，教授当着三十名同学的面，一遍又一遍地跟着我重复我的名字。

ex.s: The awkward moment ended with the class erupting into laughter.
ex.t: 为了美术O-level考试，我需要交一幅油画作品。

ex.s: In a class discussion, I was invited to explain the meaning of my name.
ex.t: 在一次课堂讨论中，我被邀请解释我名字的含义。

ex.s: Loan periods are established by the lending library.
ex.t: 一切都感觉自由而轻松。

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: （10分）Some people live to climb the highest mountains． Some people live only dreaming about it while others live to avoid ever climbing at all． But one thing is certain， all people encounter mountains in their life．
ex.t: 21．（10分）有些人活着是为了攀登最高的山峰。有些人只活在梦想里，而另一些人活着则完全避免去爬。但有一件事是确定的：所有人一生中都会遇到山。

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。一天放学后，在探索这座壮丽山林的绿色树林时，我差点摔倒在一组台阶上。这些台阶会通向哪里？好奇心占了上风，因为我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些奇怪而神秘的台阶。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 我爬呀爬，除了绿色的灌木丛和这些台阶什么都没有。我必须到达山顶！

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。
